subject: System Design
title: Graceful Degradation
description: A fast breakdown of Graceful Degradation for builders.

hook.text: The recommendation engine is down. Does the entire shopping site crash? Or does it show popular items instead?

buildup.text: Graceful degradation means reducing functionality instead of failing completely when a component breaks.

discovery.text: Netflix degrades by showing cached content when its personalization service fails. Users barely notice.

twist.text: Graceful degradation must be designed and tested in advance. You can't improvise it during an outage.

climax.text: The best systems fail partially, not totally. Users get a reduced experience, not an error page.

punchline.text: Fail partially, not completely — keep the core working.

quiz.question: What is graceful degradation?
options: Reducing functionality instead of failing completely
